title: Subperiosteal implant perforated flap, a combination technique for immediate maxillary reconstruction and dental rehabilitation
html: The purpose of this study is to propose a new approach for rehabilitation of low-level maxillary defects immediately after ablation or atrophic maxillary reconstruction, using patient-specific subperiosteal implants combined with a perforated microvascular soft-tissue free flap. Eight consecutive patients were treated and followed for an average of 196 days. The sample consisted of patients with any low-level maxillary defect, Brown class I or II. All patients received a patient-specific implant designed with abutments to retain a fixed dental prosthesis, with a soft-tissue free flap harvested from the forearm within the same operation to provide soft tissue coverage.
